purpose: 50 curated landscape artworks for a prospective Frame Gallery Commons source; research only, not an app/runtime manifest.

selection_criteria.taste: Mostly colourful classical modernism, abstraction, expressionism, geometric art and a few quieter watercolours.
selection_criteria.duplicates: One file per selected artwork; Composition VII and its separate watercolor study are intentionally distinct.

limitations: Landscape does not mean 16:9. None meets the existing strict ±1% 16:9 match; contain/no-crop presentation therefore leaves borders. This research does not change the application's filters or fallback behavior.

Commons rights labels and file-page templates were checked, but are not a warranty or worldwide legal clearance. In particular the Delaunay files explicitly flagged below require additional US-basis review before release.

Metadata and licence labels should be revalidated at integration/release time. Artwork date fields are raw source fields, may be absent or describe a photograph, and must not be blindly used as creation years.

All 50 final previews were visually inspected in this run. This is not full-resolution download/decode validation or TV testing; those remain future integration work. Original paper/support margins can be present.
No Home Assistant or television access, no application code changes, no installation, no publication and no artwork image files saved to this repository.
